jobs.description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.
This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.
One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)
The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:
You are flexible
You are able to do physical work 
You can work well in a team
You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:
English

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.
- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:
You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

About the Role
 

We are looking for a versatile and reliable Administrative & Finance Support Officer to join our Finance & Administration team.
 

This is not a role for an accounting specialist, nor are we searching for the next CFO of the group. Instead, we are looking for a well-organized administrative professional who is comfortable with numbers, has a practical mindset, and enjoys bringing structure and order to daily operations.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Processing and monitoring bank statements 
 
• Managing and reviewing expense reports 
 
• Verifying and following up on supplier invoices 
 
• Updating Excel files and internal databases 
 
• Document management and filing 
 
• Providing general administrative support to the Finance & Administration department 
 
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• Previous experience in an administrative, back-office, or financial support role 
 
• Experience working with an ERP system or integrated business software is a strong asset 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams 
 
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 
• Reliable and trustworthy professional attitude 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• Practical mindset and willingness to build a long-term career within the company 
 

We also appreciate people who ask questions when they don't know something rather than allowing the problem to mature quietly in their inbox.
 

 
 

Language Skills
 
 
 
• Good professional command of French and/or Dutch 
 
• Practical knowledge of English, allowing you to communicate by email, phone, and Microsoft Teams in a professional environment 
 
• Willingness to further develop your English skills as part of the role 
 

Being trilingual is certainly an advantage, but we are not necessarily looking for a simultaneous interpreter for the European Commission.

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.
